blocks.title: Observe
blocks.text: BRA always changes which instruction is fetched next; BRZ branches only when ACC is zero.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: The loop's memory variable COUNT changes after SUB ONE and STA COUNT. Reload it with LDA COUNT at each iteration.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Trace ACC, COUNT, branch decision and outputs. Stopping before OUT when COUNT=0 prevents printing zero.

blocks.title: Worked example · Follow the reasoning
blocks.text: Outputs2 then1; COUNT reaches0, and BRZ branches before OUT.

blocks.title: Follow the reasoning
blocks.text: Outputs4 then2; stored COUNT becomes0, and BRZ exits before the next OUT.
